items.headline: Gulf escalation remains active as Brent trades around $92 and U.S. 10-year yield nears 4.79%
items.summary: Reuters reports Brent around $92.20 and the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield near 4.79% as Gulf tensions, inflation concerns and a global bond selloff continue. The combination keeps financial-conditions and volatility risk elevated for crypto and other risk assets.
items.whyItMatters: Sustained energy and bond-market stress can tighten financial conditions, strengthen the dollar and amplify risk-off liquidity and volatility across BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, AVAX and HBAR.
items.actionReason: The existing HIGH-impact macro/geopolitical shock remains active. This is contextual only and does not create a Crypto Reca buy, sell, reduce or exit signal.

items.headline: August 31 U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs finish with +$216.7M net inflow
items.summary: Farside shows a complete Aug. 31 total of +$216.7M, led by IBIT +$205.9M, reversing the prior session's -$201.9M outflow. The confirmed rebound improves institutional-flow context but does not create a Crypto Reca buy signal.
items.whyItMatters: A material return to net inflows after the Aug. 28 outflow indicates renewed spot ETF demand and constitutes a meaningful reversal in short-term institutional-flow context.
items.actionReason: Positive ETF flow is supportive context only. Crypto Reca still requires independent technical qualification and execution gates.

items.headline: August 31 U.S. spot Ether ETFs finish with +$87.6M net inflow
items.summary: Farside-sourced data now shows a complete Aug. 31 net inflow of +$87.6M, led by ETHA +$59.9M, with FETH +$9.3M, ETHW +$3.7M, TETH +$1.2M and Grayscale ETH +$13.5M. The completed print materially upgrades the earlier partial +$27.7M reading.
items.whyItMatters: The final flow confirms meaningful institutional spot demand for ETH and resolves the earlier incomplete reading, improving short-term liquidity context.
items.actionReason: Positive ETF flow is supportive context only and never creates a Crypto Reca buy signal; independent technical qualification remains mandatory.

catalysts.headline: U.S. JOLTS for July 2026 due at 16:00 Madrid
catalysts.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics schedules July 2026 Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey data for Sept. 1 at 10:00 a.m. ET (16:00 Madrid). The release is inside the six-hour event window.
catalysts.whyItMatters: A material surprise in job openings, hiring or quits can reprice Fed expectations, Treasury yields and the dollar, transmitting quickly to crypto liquidity and volatility.
catalysts.actionReason: HIGH-impact U.S. labor-market data is due within six hours. This is event-risk context only and does not override Crypto Reca technical gates.

catalysts.headline: U.S. ISM Manufacturing PMI for August 2026 due at 16:00 Madrid
catalysts.summary: Institute for Supply Management schedules the August 2026 Manufacturing PMI for Sept. 1 at 10:00 a.m. ET (16:00 Madrid). The release is inside the six-hour event window.
catalysts.whyItMatters: Manufacturing growth, new orders, employment and prices-paid components can move growth/inflation expectations, yields and risk-asset positioning.
catalysts.actionReason: HIGH-impact U.S. macro data is due within six hours. This is contextual event risk only and cannot create a buy or sell signal.

catalysts.headline: Ripple monthly XRP escrow release window opens
catalysts.summary: Public XRP Ledger tracking indicates that up to 1 billion XRP is scheduled to become releasable from escrow on Sept. 1. The amount actually entering circulation cannot be known in advance because unused XRP is commonly re-escrowed.
catalysts.sourceName: XRP Insights / XRP Ledger escrow tracking
catalysts.whyItMatters: The event can focus attention on XRP supply, but the headline unlock is not equivalent to a 1 billion XRP market sale or net supply increase.
catalysts.actionReason: Wait for validated on-chain EscrowFinish and re-escrow activity before drawing supply conclusions.

catalysts.headline: U.S. Employment Situation for August 2026
catalysts.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics schedules the August 2026 Employment Situation report for Sept. 4 at 8:30 a.m. ET (14:30 Madrid).
catalysts.whyItMatters: Payrolls, unemployment and wage data can materially reprice Fed expectations, yields and the dollar.
catalysts.actionReason: More than 24 hours away; no escalation yet.
